subtasks.title: Run project quality gates and confirm the PresenceTracker/warm-feed/classify-mixed tests pass
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/006_8f4080956ee0/architecture/verification_findings.md §4 and §6. The project's validate.sh at plan/005_8b95ea464bd9/validate.sh defines 7 phases. The core dev-loop gate per AGENTS.md is single-threaded tests (--test-threads=1) because of shared global debouncer state. The relevant tests live in src/core/notifier.rs and MUST be run single-threaded.
2. INPUT: No code input needed — this is a verification subtask that runs the existing test suite and build gates against the already-shipped code (commit d240b27).
3. LOGIC: Run in sequence (each must pass before the next matters):
   (a) cargo fmt --all --check
   (b) cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
   (c) cargo build --release
   (d) cargo build --release --no-default-features  (trayless build, the documented caveat path)
   (e) cargo test --bin qmkonnect -- --test-threads=1
   Report the total test count from (e). Then explicitly confirm these specific tests PASS (grep the test output for their names):
     - test_presence_tick_capable_unplug_with_non_capable_remaining_is_loss (notifier.rs:3012)
     - test_presence_tick_capable_replug_different_board_is_gain (notifier.rs:3026)
     - test_presence_tick_stable_bus_no_reprobe_no_action (notifier.rs:3037)
     - test_handshake_warm_eligible_single_board_only (notifier.rs:4097)
     - test_classify_candidates_mixed (notifier.rs:3894)
4. OUTPUT: A pass/fail report for each gate (a)-(e) plus the explicit confirmation that the 5 named tests passed. If any gate fails, capture the exact error output and flag it as a regression to investigate.

subtasks.title: Confirm documented caveats have backing behavior (read-only code audit)
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/006_8f4080956ee0/architecture/verification_findings.md §1 and §1.5. All four caveats have been verified as having backing behavior during this research phase. This subtask re-confirms independently.
2. INPUT: The source file src/core/notifier.rs (4107 lines) and src/runners/linux.rs. No external services are involved — this is a static read-only code audit.
3. LOGIC: Verify each of the four documented caveats by reading the relevant code:
   (a) Proto-v1 picker caveat — confirm classify_devices (src/core/notifier.rs:1123) does NOT gate on HAS_HANDSHAKED, while perform_handshake_with (:428) DOES (the swap). This asymmetry is the documented proto-v1 exception.
   (b) Warm-feed scope — confirm warm_cache_from_handshake (:1163) early-returns on !handshake_warm_eligible(candidates.len()), and handshake_warm_eligible (:1141) rejects >=2 boards (returns candidate_count <= 1).
   (c) Trayless caveat — confirm src/runners/linux.rs:26-32 runs perform_handshake once at startup if is_device_connected(), and that the systemd template (packaging/linux/systemd/qmkonnect.service.template) has BindsTo + Restart=always.
   (d) Status-poll never pings on a stable bus — confirm PresenceTracker::tick (:1311) only calls classify_devices when paths != self.last_paths (the paths_changed branch), so on a stable bus reprobed is None and no ping occurs.
   For each, read the actual code lines and report whether the behavior matches. NO code changes expected.
4. OUTPUT: A 4-row audit report (Caveat | Code location read | Expected behavior | Confirmed Y/N). If any audit item FAILS, flag it explicitly — that would be the only scenario where this delta gains a follow-on fix task. Otherwise the delta closes as verified-complete.
5. DOCS: none — this is a read-only code audit.
